specification:
GEOMETRY ROOT — [ACTOR_1] is positioned immediately behind [ACTOR_2] in a close rear-aligned standing hinge. [ACTOR_2] bends forward through the hip joints with mild anterior pelvic tilt, a gentle inward lumbar line, and softly flexed knees; avoid a rounded upper/lower-back silhouette. Both actors retain their assigned body and furniture support contacts.

BASE SUPPORT GEOMETRY — USER-SUPPLIED DESIGN CONSTRAINTS, not image-observed: [ACTOR_1] uses an asymmetric split stance by elevating one rear leg on a separate surface while [ACTOR_2] retains a supported forward hinge. The rear pelvis and torso angle may shift naturally from the changed support height but are not over-prescribed. FRONT SUPPORT: Both feet of [ACTOR_2] remain grounded on [FLOOR] while both hands brace a waist-height or near-waist-height support edge. The front posture otherwise follows the USDG-style hinge silhouette. REAR SUPPORT: One foot of [ACTOR_1] stays on [FLOOR]; the opposite foot or knee rests on an elevated support surface according to the active variant.

STRUCTURAL VARIATION — The user-specified baseline keeps the rear participant with one foot elevated at knee height while the front participant uses edge support.

V00 REAR ARM DEFAULT — Both rear forearms travel forward outside the front upper arms; the palms settle near the outer shoulders/upper arms and turn inward, keeping the two upper torsos closely aligned. Baseline rear-arm placement; no additional variation angle.

CONTACT ARRANGEMENT — Two rear arms may be used for shoulder, underarm or chest-level routes; at forehead, mouth-line or neck-side destinations, one rear hand takes the upper destination and the other makes a single opposite-side hip cup.

INHERITANCE AND SUPPORT — Preserve the exact named leg/surface support topology and independent balance anchors from the base. Parent: UADG-RELV-V00. No paired inheritance change.

SOURCE BOUNDARY — User-designed text geometry, no source photograph or demonstrated physical pose; geometry and model fidelity remain untested.
